title: Launch a real loopback-only browser for the existing owner-authorized Command Incident to Investigate Case Timeline journey
goal: Replace test-only browser path with a runnable no-paid-API local first-party Go server mounting existing Command Work Queue and Investigate Case Timeline handlers, a minimal ephemeral browser Basic challenge, two independently checked synthetic owners and a visible corrected Case timeline. Real browser navigation; no network deployment, production identity provider or data source.
invariants: Do not create a second router, owner engine, HTTP endpoint or Case projection; use exact pre-existing Command and Investigate HTTP handlers and same-origin router
Never bind non-loopback; reject non-loopback Host header, require a newly generated high entropy Basic password on every execution and do not place credentials in URLs or cookies
Host-authenticated principal is evaluated independently by each product owner and each per-object source owner, never forwarded as implicit Command permission
Demo data are explicitly synthetic and immutable; no real tenant, production IAM, paid API, persistence or mutation, OPEN-013 remains out of scope
Never mistake a local Basic challenge on HTTP loopback for production security; owner must supply IAM, HTTPS, CSRF protection and real authoritative data for deployment
security_properties: 32 bytes cryptographic random per role; constant time comparison; fail closed if entropy missing
Reject host header not 127.0.0.1 and bind only 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port; no remote listener, no token in URL; generic 401 with browser Basic challenge
Commander can read Command Incident but cannot elevate to Investigate Case/Timeline, and denied source versions/foreign sources never display

migration.rationale: Standalone opt-in local demonstration entrypoint only; no database, schema or authorization change.

rollback.strategy: Delete standalone cmd/local-browser and bounded work files; original hosts/CI unchanged.
verification: Original Command->Investigate host routing tests remain untouched

inputs: CAP-CMD-106 linked Case selection and CAP-INV-110 owner-authorized browser timeline
Existing same-origin host, Go modules and optional HTML filtering from PR #201; synthetic memory owners
outputs: go run ./cmd/local-browser starts real 127.0.0.1 ephemeral HTTP server, displays one-time credentials and URL, supports actual browser Basic challenge
Following same-origin Incident Case link renders source-authorized Case Timeline HTML with supersession, filters and pages, no manually injected Authorization header
Negative live HTTP Basic principal/source denial and DNS rebinding Host tests
acceptance_tests: A real loopback HTTP client authenticates as analyst and follows actual selected Incident-linked Case into owner-authorized Timeline HTML; source v1 is marked superseded by v2 and filters work
Commander with separate valid credentials can access Incident but not Investigate Case, even if URL is manually supplied; invalid/missing Basic secret denied
Host header spoof, unsupported/remote origin and unsupported path denied; no Basic credentials in links; no-store and no-referrer preserved
Go host+subcommand tests/vet/race and full mandatory engineering kernel pass on exact candidate SHA
definition_of_ready: Existing 201 source of tested same-origin Go and Case HTML filter handlers at frozen SHA dc714668f4e50deeb92057dc89a0c5911d104893
No trusted/production IAM decision taken; local demonstration explicitly optional
definition_of_done: Actual runnable localhost binary with tested browser-native Basic realm and deterministic synthetic fixtures
Cross-principal source denial and owner-separated HTTP proof on exact GitHub SHA
Not a production delivery, no native APPROVED or upstream merged claim

performance_budget.rationale: Small local bounded HTTP demo; no production SLO; inherited existing runtime module and request limits
